llm_response.reason: The website uses fake Windows Defender alerts, pop-up warnings of malware, and urgent language to induce fear. It impersonates Microsoft branding, provides a suspicious tech support phone number, and instructs users not to leave the page and instead call for help immediately. These are classic hallmarks of a technical support scam, including psychological manipulation, fake system warnings, and the spoofing of legitimate security notifications. The site is hosted on a cloud storage domain and not an official Microsoft site.
